_readme: Expected fleet identity state. jlapenna/homelab's bin/emit-iam-contract-metrics.py reads this file from main and diffs it against live GitHub and GCP (docs/iam-contract.md). docs/fleet-credentials.md is the prose; change them together (#1376).
_fleetRepositoriesNote: Must stay identical to local.github_repositories in infra/terraform/main.tf - the shared 'github' WIF pool's attribute_condition is generated from it, and tools/contract-tests/iam-contract-model.test.ts asserts the two agree without needing any credentials.

githubApps._note: What the agent lanes and the console authenticate as - claims, PRs and comments land as agent-lcars[bot]. Private key: Secret Manager AGENT_LCARS_APP_PRIVATE_KEY (project agent-lcars) / repo secret AGENT_LCARS_PRIVATE_KEY.

installations._note: The maintainer chose All repositories (2026-10-12), so only the selection is asserted: a repository list would mirror the account and make every new repository drift.
The maintainer chose All repositories (2026-10-28), so only the selection is asserted: a repository list would mirror the organization and make every new repository drift.

githubApps._checksNote: checks: write since 2026-11-19 so the bot can publish Homelab code-review check runs (jlapenna/homelab#3647).

installations._note: The maintainer chose All repositories (2026-10-12), so only the selection is asserted: a repository list would mirror the account and make every new repository drift.
#1381 decided to narrow this installation to the three fleet repos (sprinkles, www, girosf); when that UI change happens, set repositorySelection to 'selected' and list them.

githubApps._note: What runner scale-set listeners register with. Its private key is deployed on the homelab controller for those listeners (github-runner-autoscaler/lcars-app-private-key.pem) and the collector reads it there in place, so this App is asserted from the same host with no new key distribution (jlapenna/homelab#768). It was previously modelled as unassertable on the belief that the key only existed in the ansible vault; that was wrong. Its former actions:read grant (2026-09-20) served only the github-actions-exporter's REST polling (jlapenna/agent-lcars#2024) and was removed once the exporter moved to App webhooks over Pub/Sub (jlapenna/agent-lcars#3525). Prose: docs/fleet-credentials.md ('Actions exporter key').

Dedicated review identity for every review run and automatic dependency approval; implementation authors are unchanged. Private key is in the existing Secret Manager AGENT_LCARS_AUTHOR_APP_PRIVATE_KEY slot, exposed to Console as AGENT_LCARS_REVIEWER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.

_fleetCoverageNote: Every entry in fleetRepositories must be covered by some App installation. supersprinklesracing/www was found uncovered this way (#1380).
_userManagedKeyNote: No fleet service account should hold a user-managed key. The allowlists above are a ratchet: an unlisted key is a failure, and a listed account that no longer holds a key is ALSO a failure, so a retired exemption cannot be silently inherited by the next key.

agent-lcars._note: Terraform-managed by infra/terraform in this repo.

userManagedKeyAllowlist.reason: The host writer credential (Secret Manager AGENT_TELEMETRY_WRITER_KEY_JSON) is consumed by the homelab telemetry watcher outside GitHub Actions, which has no OIDC identity to federate. Every other fleet identity authenticates over WIF and must hold no key.

The dedicated Work scheduler credential (#3217; Homelab vault agent_lcars_scheduler_key_json, mounted as LCARS_SCHEDULER_CREDENTIALS) is consumed only by the homelab runner-autoscaler's schedule and maintenance ticker, which runs outside GitHub Actions and has no OIDC identity to federate. It is never mounted into runner pods, so the work.cron and repository-job automation authority stays off the executor key.

The homelab-ops claw zone executor credential (agent-lcars#3349; Homelab vault claw_zone_executor_key_json) is consumed only by the zone's QueueExecutor instance on the homelab controller, which runs outside GitHub Actions and has no OIDC identity to federate. Its Work grant admits work.executor for the zone's claw pipelines only, and it is never mounted into claw Job pods.

The GitHub Actions exporter's event subscriber credential (agent-lcars#3525; Homelab vault github_actions_exporter_key_json) is consumed only by the exporter container on the homelab controller, which runs outside GitHub Actions and has no OIDC identity to federate. It holds roles/pubsub.subscriber on the github-actions-exporter subscription and nothing else.

The laforge delivery agent's event subscriber credential (agent-lcars#3568; Homelab vault agent_events_laforge_key_json) is consumed only by lcars events agent, a user service on laforge outside GitHub Actions with no OIDC identity to federate. It holds roles/pubsub.subscriber on the agent-events-laforge subscription and the events.deliver Work grant, and nothing else.

The pike delivery agent's event subscriber credential (agent-lcars#3568; Homelab vault agent_events_pike_key_json) is consumed only by lcars events agent, a user service on pike outside GitHub Actions with no OIDC identity to federate. It holds roles/pubsub.subscriber on the agent-events-pike subscription and the events.deliver Work grant, and nothing else.

supersprinklesracing._note: claude-agent-pool is Terraform-managed by jlapenna/homelab (terraform/gcp_sprinkles_wif.tf, homelab#750): change its condition THERE. gcloud ... update-oidc --attribute-condition replaces rather than appends.

supersprinklesracing.svc.id.goog._note: GKE workload-identity pool, created and owned by GCP. ListWorkloadIdentityPoolProviders is not supported on it, so only its existence and state are asserted.

www-github._note: The www site-deploy provider. Created outside Terraform and undeclared until this check caught it (homelab#1497); homelab#1511 then declared it in terraform/gcp_sprinkles_wif.tf and imported it (2 imported, 0 added, 0 changed). Modelled here only because it is now managed -- adding it while it was still hand-made would have silenced a true positive rather than fixing what the check found. Deliberately narrower than claude-agent-github: one workflow file, main only. The site moved into supersprinklesracing/sprinkles as apps/www (sprinkles#6484), so it now admits sprinkles' www.yml. It maps no attribute.repository, because claude-agent-readonly@ is bound to attribute.repository/supersprinklesracing/sprinkles in this pool and a token from this provider would inherit that; www-deploy@ is bound to workflow_class 'www-deploy' instead, a value claude-agent-github never produces.

girosf-github._note: The GiroSF site deploy provider (supersprinklesracing/sprinkles#6496), declared in homelab terraform/gcp_sprinkles_wif.tf. Same shape as www-github: one workflow file (sprinkles' girosf.yml), main only, no attribute.repository mapping. It reaches only girosf-deploy@girosf (firebasehosting.admin + firebase.viewer, no keys), bound to workflow_class 'girosf-deploy'. It replaces the exported FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_GIROSF key.

secretIamPolicies.rationale: Exactly one binding. Two speculative accessor grants were added while chasing #1368 and pruned the same night; nothing but this check stops the next ones from persisting. The reader is claude-token-reader, with zero GitHub Actions WIF impersonation bindings since hosted agent lanes retired (#1599); QueueExecutor pods receive claude-code-oauth-token via Homelab's lcars-runner-credentials Kubernetes Secret (ansible/deploy_queue_kubernetes.yml).

serviceAccountIamPolicies.rationale: The Work API identity for interactive maintainer sessions (jlapenna/agent-lcars#2502), retaining its historical work-reader name. Its Console grant carries work.reader, costs.reader and work.operator for the four coding pipelines, and it holds no project role. Exactly one principal - the maintainer's Google account - may mint its tokens; another member would extend Work operator access to that principal. Declared by google_service_account_iam_member.work_reader_token_creator in infra/terraform/main.tf.

The maintainer's claw admission identity for interactive sessions (agent-lcars#3349). Its Console grant carries only work.claw.admit for the claw pipelines (admit and cancel its own read-only investigations), and it holds no project role or key. Exactly one principal - the maintainer's Google account - may mint its tokens; another member would extend claw admission to that principal. Declared by google_service_account_iam_member.claw_operator_token_creator in infra/terraform/main.tf.
